    def __init__(self, size):
        self.size = size
        self.data = {}

    def put(self, key, value):
        self.data[key] = value
        self.trim()

    def trim(self):
        while len(self.data) > self.size:

close() shuts the socket down, closes it and sets it to None; reset() calls close(), empties the buffer and opens the socket again.
parse() matches the line against PATTERN: on a match it strips the value, otherwise the key is None and the value is the whole line; it returns both.
